concerns.text: The plan refers to the column `stimulus_type` (e.g., in FR‑001 description) but the data‑model defines this attribute as `stimulus_condition` in the Stimulus entity. This naming mismatch will cause schema validation failures and break the cleaning script that expects the data‑model name.

concerns.location: plan.md:Mapping of Functional Requirements to Pipeline Phases table (FR‑006 description)
concerns.text: The plan mentions an `MMSE` column for exclusion, while the dataset contract (`contracts/dataset.schema.yaml`) names the field `mmse_score`. The inconsistency may lead to the MMSE exclusion step never being triggered.

The Stimulus entity uses the attribute name `stimulus_condition`, which does not match the `stimulus_type` field required by the dataset schema and referenced throughout the plan. Align the attribute name across the data‑model, contracts, and plan.
